title: English articles
text: English indefinite articles a and an introduce singular countable nouns. Choose an before a vowel sound. The definite article the refers to an identifiable referent. Context determines specificity.

title: Present perfect
text: The English present perfect uses have or has with a past participle. It connects past experience or activity to the present. A definite finished past time usually calls for the simple past.

title: Polite requests
text: English requests can use can, could or would. Could you and would you are common ways to soften a request. Politeness depends on context and relationship, not only the selected modal.
